stories.headline: Anthropic Begins Public Testing of Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5
stories.blurb: Anthropic is quietly testing its upcoming Fable 5.2 and flagship Opus 5.5 models, signaling an imminent release in the highly competitive frontier model landscape.

stories.headline: Early Evaluation of GPT-6 Astra Shows Promising Robotics Performance
stories.blurb: A new paper details the performance of OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra on robot training benchmarks, demonstrating unexpected capabilities in zero-shot robot policy generation.

stories.headline: Alibaba Unveils Custom AI Chip to Power Massive Data Centers
stories.blurb: Alibaba has introduced a proprietary AI processor designed to support its ambitious plan of driving 20 gigawatts of data center capacity by 2032.

stories.headline: DeepSeek to Train Future AI Models on Huawei and Domestic Silicon
stories.blurb: DeepSeek's founder announced that the company's next-generation models will rely on Huawei and domestic Chinese hardware, navigating around tightening US chip restrictions.

stories.headline: NASA Open-Sources SpaceWasm, a Flight-Compliant WebAssembly Interpreter
stories.blurb: NASA has released a flight-qualified WebAssembly interpreter designed to safely execute sandboxed, modular code in extreme aerospace environments.

stories.headline: Linear Redesigns Its CI to Survive the Flood of AI-Generated Code
stories.blurb: Linear detailed how the sheer volume of rapid pull requests generated by AI coding tools forced them to overhaul their continuous integration architecture to prevent critical bottlenecks.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Announces General Availability of Python Workers
stories.blurb: Developers can now write serverless Cloudflare Workers in Python with native startup speeds and full integration into the Cloudflare ecosystem.

stories.headline: Testing Postgres on NVMe to Bridge OLTP and OLAP
stories.blurb: A deep dive into modern NVMe capabilities reveals how fast hardware allows Postgres to effectively converge transactional and analytical processing workloads without specialized database splits.

stories.headline: Meta Builds 'Petal,' the First Petabit-Class Transoceanic Subsea Cable
stories.blurb: Meta's engineering team detailed the development of Petal, a groundbreaking subsea fiber optic cable designed to handle unprecedented transoceanic data demands.

stories.headline: Texas Pauses Data Center Permits Pending Grid Audit
stories.blurb: Citing extreme strain on the state's power grid, Texas authorities have ordered a temporary freeze on new data center permits until a comprehensive infrastructure audit is completed.

stories.headline: macOS Silently Enables Login Keychain Data Protection
stories.blurb: A quiet update in macOS 26.4 has enabled stricter login keychain protection, improving local credential security but potentially breaking some developer workflows.
